Jason, saw Remodel Health posted over 150 percent profitable ICHRA sales growth and is scaling hard into 2026.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market employers and brokers worth a conversation than the East Coast team can reach before the moment passes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Remodel Health off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jason, quick follow-up for Remodel Health.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
